snippet.title: Scientific project: Optic - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Scientific Project: Optic is a first-person 3D puzzle game that takes players through the most important breakthroughs in the history of optics — from Newton to modern fiber optics. In this game, light is not just a visual effect but the key to solving puzzles, immersing in the atmosphere of scientific exploration, and experiencing the groundbreaking ideas of humankind.
